contract: The TCP proxy accepts writes but discards payloads to and from the affected authority without injecting a transport error. Client timeouts and reconnects use the real drivers.
The replica reports authority failure, and the test confirms that the fault actually discarded bytes.
The parent then disables the KV key or deletes the SQL team through its unaffected direct connection.
The reader cannot observe the changed authority revision. Its original sixty-second permission expires using real time and the native elapsed counter.
The test measures time after the durable mutation. Outage detection consumes about two seconds of the original lifetime before that measurement starts.
After transport recovery, a fresh reader refuses the withdrawn permission.
